metadata.description: Claude Code plugins that ship with docz.

plugins.name: docz
plugins.description: Documentation lifecycle management with the docz CLI: creating, validating, and publishing RFCs, ADRs, design docs, implementation plans, investigations, and runbooks.

plugins.name: docz-review
plugins.description: Blocks the end of a turn on a browser review of every docz document the agent created, and feeds the reviewer's answers back as the next instruction.

plugins.name: docz-html
plugins.description: Turns a docz document into one standalone HTML page in docz's theme, for readers outside the repository.
